claims.claim: Privately held firms account for roughly 60 percent of the total outstanding debt of U.S. nonfinancial firms.

evidence.text: Privately held firms account for roughly 60 percent of the total outstanding debt of U.S. nonfinancial firms. Riskier debt owed by privately held firms—primarily leveraged loans and private credit—has continued to grow at a solid pace, albeit slower than in previous years, and currently makes up about 10 percent of total outstanding nonfinancial business debt.
